privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor's own privacy policy (Section 3.2) lists a distinct purpose for face data: 'To improve the accuracy and quality of our image generation models' - i.e. the vendor reserves the right to use customer face data to improve its own models. Separately, third-party provider OpenAI is stated not to train on data submitted through its API (retained max 30 days for abuse monitoring). Face data is retained 7 days for uploaded images; raw account-saved images deleted within 30 days; account deletion cleanup within 90 days. Because the vendor's own model-improvement use of face data is not scoped or opt-out in the policy, trains_on_customer_data is treated as true pending clarification.
privacy.data_region: United States and European Union (face data stored in both regions per section 3.6)

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Mentioned generally; all third-party transmissions explicitly stated as secure but no TLS version or cipher detail provided

security.value: Access restricted to personnel who require it to perform job functions; no zero-trust or role-based detail

security.name: Data retention (face data)
security.value: Uploaded images retained max 7 days after delivery; processed feature data 30 days; account deletion cleanup 90 days

security.name: Third-party processors
security.value: AWS, Cloudflare, OpenAI, Replicate, Google Cloud, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, Intercom, Stripe contractually restricted from using data for their own purposes

products.name: StarryAI Web App
products.data_scope: Text prompts, uploaded images, face data for likeness-based generation, usage logs, account data
products.notes: Free tier with daily credits (5 lumens = 25 images); paid tiers. Generates images via Replicate/OpenAI infrastructure. Face data explicitly handled with user consent.

products.name: StarryAI Mobile App (iOS/Android)
products.data_scope: Same as web app plus device identifiers (IDFA/GAID), analytics, mobile network info
products.notes: App Store and Google Play availability. Includes third-party analytics (Mixpanel, AppsFlyer) for attribution.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: free daily credits + paid lumens/subscriptions
compare.data_residency: US and EU (flexible based on feature; face data in both regions)
